validator.source_text:
<?ui-args --schema urn:example:ext=tests/ui/schemas/extension.xsd?>
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" xmlns:x="urn:example:ext" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="a">
  <state id="a">
    <onentry>
      <log label="l"><x:note>reviewed</x:note></log>
      <cancel sendid="s"><x:note>reviewed</x:note></cancel>
      <send event="e"><param name="p" expr="1"><x:note>reviewed</x:note></param></send>
      <script><x:note>reviewed</x:note></script>
    </onentry>
    <transition event="go" target="done"/>
  </state>
  <final id="done"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: this compiler cannot lower `<x:note>` from namespace `urn:example:ext` inside `<log>`

secondary.message: this compiler lowers no child elements of `<log>`

notes: this is a limit of this toolchain, not an SCXML rule: SCXML 1.0 allows elements from other namespaces in its content models (the W3C schema's `##other` wildcards), but the compiler lowers them only as executable content (custom actions in `<onentry>`, `<onexit>`, `<transition>`, `<finalize>`, `<if>`, or `<foreach>`) and rejects them anywhere else rather than drop them silently
diagnostics.help: to compile the document with this toolchain, move the element into executable content, or remove it
